Package com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.item

Class MBItem

java.lang.Object
net.minecraft.world.item.Item
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.item.MBItem
All Implemented Interfaces:
VariableStackItem, net.minecraft.world.flag.FeatureElement, net.minecraft.world.level.ItemLike
public class MBItem extends net.minecraft.world.item.Item implements VariableStackItem
FIFO storage for full mob snapshots, limited to one exact entity type per bucket. Capture appends an eligible live mob only after authorization; release recreates the oldest snapshot and removes it from storage only after the entity enters the world. FILLED_PROPERTY exposes the empty-versus-occupied item-model state.

    • canCapture

      public static boolean canCapture(net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity entity)
      Whether an entity may be stored in a Mob Bucket at all, independent of what the bucket already holds. Excludes players and other non-Mob living entities, types that cannot be serialized, blacklisted types, and entities involved in a ride, since the other half of the pair is not part of the snapshot.

    • capture

      public static boolean capture(net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack, net.minecraft.world.entity.Mob mob, ProtectionContext context, net.minecraft.core.Direction face)
      Captures one eligible, type-compatible mob after authorizing the supplied interaction face. A water-dwelling mob also takes the water source block it occupies, so a release followed by a recapture cannot generate a free-standing water block.
      Returns:
      true only after the snapshot is appended and the live mob is discarded; false leaves the mob, bucket, and world unchanged

    • needsWater

    • releaseOldest

      public static boolean releaseOldest(net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel level, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos pos, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack, ProtectionContext context, net.minecraft.core.Direction face)
      Attempts to recreate and release the oldest stored mob at pos.

      The recreated entity retains its saved UUID unless that UUID belongs to another loaded entity in any server level, in which case a fresh UUID is chosen. Collision failure and entity-release or required-fluid protection denial preserve the stored entry and destination. The entry is removed only after ServerLevel.addFreshEntity(Entity) succeeds. Required water is committed before that final insertion; if another mod rejects insertion afterward, the snapshot remains stored but the water is not rolled back.

      Returns:
      true only after the entity enters the world and the oldest snapshot is removed
